items.title: Quasi-coherent modules on a chaotic site with flat restrictions form a weak Serre subcategory
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that when the chaotic site is endowed with a sheaf of rings whose restriction maps are flat, the quasi-coherent modules form a weak Serre subcategory. The proof checks the defining property: it starts with a five-term exact sequence whose outer four terms are quasi-coherent, uses the base-change characterization of quasi-coherence on the chaotic topology, and considers the commutative diagram obtained by tensoring each term with O(U) over O(V); flatness of the restriction maps makes the two rows exact, so the base-change map for the middle term is an isomorphism by the five lemma, whence the middle term is quasi-coherent (proof lines 3606-3641). H2: the diagram chase through the five lemma, with flatness as the hypothesis that keeps the rows exact, is the substance.
